Copilot instructions for the WHT applicationThis repository is an incremental Django application for withholding-tax transaction classification and review.Mandatory working methodDo not build the whole application at once.Work on only the phase explicitly requested.Before modifying code, explain the planned change and affected files.After the change, run tests and report the result.Stop after completing the requested step.Do not introduce future-phase functionality early.Do not invent tax rules or company policies.Use synthetic data only.Preserve leading zeros in SAP-style identifiers.Use Python Decimal for tax rates and monetary calculations.Keep suggested and human-final classifications separate.Store applied WHT rate and rule version as historical snapshots.Never silently select a record when matching is ambiguous.Put business logic in service modules, not templates or views.Add tests for every business-rule service.Do not add React, FastAPI, ML, cloud integration, or external APIs unless explicitly requested.Explain architecture decisions in simple language because the application owner is building and learning incrementally.
